Question: Let \(ABCDEF\) be a regular hexagon with side length \(1.\) Denote by \(X,\) \(Y,\) and \(Z\) the midpoints of sides \(AB,\) \(CD,\) and \(EF,\) respectively. What is the area of the convex hexagon whose interior is the intersection of the interiors of \(\triangle ACE\) and \(\triangle XYZ?\)
